test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing the north.

Only 1 person sits to the left of E. Only 2 people sit between E and F. C sits immediately to the right of D. G sits immediately to the left of A. Only 1 person sits between F and D.

How many people sit between A and E?
solution:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north.

Only 1 person sits to the left of E.

Only 2 people sit between E and F.

C sits immediately to the right of D.

G sits immediately to the left of A.

Only 1 person sits between F and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1761629a059287748334643503644f29d5b41376202ba902a50842c8f315190f.png] 

People between them are D, C, F and G = 4 people.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
